body:
This test is not intended to work for YCQL because there is no support for multiple select statements inside a single transaction. This is commented in the test code:
```
;; Shouldn't be used until we support transactions with selects.
(c/defclient CQLMultiBank keyspace []
```
https://github.com/YugaByte/jepsen/blob/master-yb/yugabyte/src/yugabyte/ycql/bank.clj#L63

As for YSQL - please double check that selects are wrapped in a transaction.

@ttyusupov Thanks, you're right, this test isn't applicable to YCQL, edited the description to refrlect that.
This still actual for YSQL though - transactions for `SELECT`s are in place.

issue.body:
(Does not affect YCQL)
We're observing inconsistency in YSQL banking test (transactionally moves funds around from one account to another) - even without any nemeses funds total diverge from initial $100

Full log: [logs-jepsen_2019-06-17_15-42-51.tar.gz](https://github.com/YugaByte/yugabyte-db/files/3296488/logs-jepsen_2019-06-17_15-42-51.tar.gz)

issue.title: [Jepsen] [YSQL] Inconsistency in single-key-acid test with high concurrency setting

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
(Does not affect YCQL)
We're observing inconsistency in YSQL single-key-acid test (concurrent read, write, update-if operations on configurable number of rows) with no nemeses when `--concurrency` setting set to 20 (given default of 5 nodes this results in 2 rows being concurrently used in a table) or 30 (3 rows)

Note that this test passes on `--concurrency 10` (1 row).

Full logs:
[logs-jepsen_2019-06-24_15-16-45_single-key-acid_c20.tar.gz](https://github.com/YugaByte/yugabyte-db/files/3320318/logs-jepsen_2019-06-24_15-16-45_single-key-acid_c20.tar.gz)
[logs-jepsen_2019-06-24_15-05-34_single-key-acid_c30.tar.gz](https://github.com/YugaByte/yugabyte-db/files/3320311/logs-jepsen_2019-06-24_15-05-34_single-key-acid_c30.tar.gz)

Reproducible with master ad50ea9, related to #938
